programmes.d: Two murders in Toronto ignite an investigation that spans four decades; breakthroughs in investigative genetic genealogy help crack the case.
A 21-year-old college senior is shot and killed in a public park just months before her graduation.
Detectives find a message written in blood during a murder investigation.
A detective and a deputy district attorney solve the decades-old murder of a young woman at a fast-food restaurant.
Law enforcement officers investigate a string of deadly shootings targeting women in the border city of Laredo, Texas.
A community comes together to search for a young woman who goes missing from a Halloween party.
A mystery looms over a small New York town when a woman is murdered and a stunning secret is exposed; more than a decade later, new developments lead to an unexpected conclusion.
The murders of two young women near a Phoenix canal remain unsolved for over 20 years until a team of cold case detectives take on the case and investigate a man known as the Zombie Hunter.
After a nurse and mother-of-three is murdered inside her Illinois home, investigators uncover security camera footage that could be key to solving the case.
When a former hockey player discovers his wife murdered in their home, his daughter says she saw a burglar.
A recent law school graduate in Georgia who has a promising future disappears without a trace.
Halloween becomes tragic for a young woman when her fiancé is killed at a local bar.
When a California nursing student disappears during her hospital shift, her family works to locate her.
When two women call 911 after hearing someone break into their apartment, their call for help holds the key to solving the mysterious murder of a young graduate student named Katie Sepich.
When a young woman is found nearly murdered in her apartment, officials wonder if it is connected to the disappearance of a young woman in nearby Denver weeks earlier.
The deadly 2020 shooting at U.S. District Court Judge Esther Salas' home, which killed her son and critically injured her husband.
The murder of a wealthy hotel heir ignites a feud between his wife and stepdaughter.
A soon-to-be bride is caught in the middle of a twisted murder plot that has detectives questioning if she played a role in it.

Two young girls in Washington are snatched in broad daylight while riding their bikes; the case goes unsolved for decades, until a new detective with a local connection to the story tries to solve the mystery.
A top-ranking officer in the Canadian military pleaded guilty to a number of crimes, from home invasions and lingerie theft to murder.

Convicted murderer Drew Peterson speaks out about the murder of his third wife and the disappearance of his fourth wife in his first network TV interview in more than a decade; insiders close to the case speak out, including Stacy Peterson's sister.

The disappearance of 19-year-old Alaska Native Sonya Ivanoff sends shockwaves through the small coastal city of Nome, Alaska; police scramble to find answers until a note is found in a stolen police vehicle telling the cops to back off or else.
